summary: PASS, no findings, on candidate sha256:6720ad2c…652922a (commit 0a652018; main HEAD 3ffb28c is a metadata-only freeze commit). No domain artefact (docs/source, docs/analysis, register, requirements-spec) changed since round 18, but I re-reviewed the scope in full. Extraction fidelity passes on a new per-paragraph containment check in both directions: all 1002 docx paragraphs are in playbook.md and no markdown text is foreign. It also passes the round-18 token diff and the cell-by-cell check of all 49 tables, and check_extraction.sh. All 165 B blocks and 423 M blocks are consistently dispositioned, and the 36 non-requirement rationales are true. T01–T16 columns and value lists are verbatim in both the field inventory and the register, as are the waves, T10 RAG logic, T11 SLAs and the RACI grid. Every first-class deliverable is fully specified. The operating-logic rules are stated with testable acceptances. SOURCE rows are grounded, and health-check scoring is labelled an assumption. Provenance and branding are honest. An 87-block stratified master-prompt sample (seed 19) is correct. Staging follows §21. The glossary, journeys and permissions are sound. prefreeze passes in a fresh clone. D-035 is an acceptable loosening. No engineering or business approval is granted by this review.
